title: US September Jobs Report Badly Misses: +29K vs 84K Forecast, Unemployment Rises to 4.2%
summary: The Bureau of Labor Statistics reported that U.S. nonfarm payrolls rose just 29,000 in September, far below the 84,000 consensus forecast and well below the 12-month average of 45,000. The unemployment rate climbed to 4.2%. Prior months were also revised down by a combined 60,000 jobs. Average hourly earnings rose just 0.1% month-on-month (+3.0% year-on-year).
why: 大幅低于预期的就业数据使市场降低对美联储10月27-28会议继续加息的预期（当前目标区间3.75-4%，9月已加25bp）；NFP弱势利好成长/科技股估值，对组合内美股标的（NVDA、TSLA、GOOGL等）的sell put仓位构成期限利好；也可能刺激港股科技短线反弹。数字出自BLS官方报告，CNBC原文引用。

title: Toshiba Plans to Double HDD Capacity With $380M Philippines Expansion; Seagate Falls 14%, Western Digital 9%, SanDisk 1.8%
summary: Nikkei Asia reported that Toshiba will invest about ¥60 billion (~$380M) to double its hard-disk drive production capacity at its Philippines plant by fiscal 2027, targeting AI data center demand. Toshiba aims to raise its HDD market share from ~10% to 30% medium-term. The announcement rattled the AI storage trade: Seagate (STX) fell ~14%, Western Digital (WDC) ~9%, and SanDisk (SNDK) ~1.8%. Morgan Stanley and Citi called the selloff overdone.
why: AI存储板块估值逻辑受冲击：HDD供给短缺叙事被东芝入局打破；持有闪迪(SNDK)的仓位需重新评估支撑位和行权价选择。摩根士丹利认为抛售过度，闪迪跌幅相对较小（1.8%），短期反弹机会可关注。

title: Gold Slides, On Track for Second Weekly Loss as 10-Year Treasury Yield Hits 5.34%
summary: Spot gold fell 0.8% to $4,145 on Friday and was down ~3.3% for the week, pressured by a stronger US dollar and surging Treasury yields. The 10-year yield touched 5.34%, its highest level since 2002, lifting the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding bullion. Gold futures opened around $4,200-4,218 before the September jobs data.
why: 黄金价格下跌直接影响老铺黄金(6181.HK)毛利率预期；10年期美债收益率升至5.34%历史高位是本周全球市场的核心压力源，拉动港股、成长股、高估值标的全线承压。CNBC引用的现货价格为市场公开数据。

title: G7 Nations Coordinate Release of Diesel and Crude Oil Reserves to Ease Surging Fuel Prices
summary: The Group of Seven nations announced a coordinated release of diesel and crude oil stockpiles to ease elevated energy prices. Brent crude fell toward $100/barrel while WTI settled around $91/barrel on Friday, both down on the day. Oil prices had risen sharply in recent weeks on Middle East tensions; the G7 move is aimed at capping further price spikes.
why: G7压制油价有助于缓和通胀预期，间接支持美联储暂缓激进加息路径；较低油价利好消费、航运、能源密集型行业，对组合内港股消费标的（美团、携程等）宏观环境有轻微正面。

title: CNBC: Micron's HBM Cash Flows Could Support a Buyback Rivaling Nvidia's Record $235B Program
summary: Following Nvidia's authorization of a record $150 billion buyback increase (total $235B through fiscal 2028), CNBC analysis suggests Micron Technology (MU) possesses the free cash flow profile to potentially execute a comparably large repurchase program as its HBM business matures. No official announcement has been made; the article frames this as a plausible next step given Micron's growing AI memory revenue.
why: 纯属分析性猜测，非官方公告，故标 verified:false；但若成真将是美光MU的重大估值催化剂，值得提前关注。持有MU的sell put仓位若MU大涨可受益；当前MU正争夺HBM4市场份额，现金流确实快速增长。

title: 腾讯9月30日再度回购23.4万股，耗资约1.003亿港元
summary: 据富途牛牛援引港交所公告，腾讯控股（0700.HK）于9月30日通过场内回购23.4万股股份，合计耗资约港币1.003亿元。腾讯自2026年5月13日董事会授权10%股本（9.118亿股）回购计划以来，已近乎每个交易日持续回购。
why: 延续报道：腾讯回购计划2026-05授权后持续执行，每日披露均构成新的HKEX公告；本条为9月30日单日数据，距今3天，归入仍在发展事件。实际数字需以HKEXnews原始公告为准，本条仅摘录富途资讯，故标 verified:false。持续回购对0700.HK有价值支撑，sell put仓位下行保护增强。
